name: record_intent
description: Records the classified intent and extracted slots for this run; the code then returns next_action (dispatch | ask_user | reject | answer_status), the stage plan, and any missing or invalid slots. Use it first in every run, exactly once, before any other tool or delegation.

run_id.description: The run_id given in the <run_id> tag of the request. Copy it verbatim.

intent.description: Exactly one intent from the taxonomy in the system prompt.

confidence.description: Your confidence in the intent label. Below 0.6 the code returns next_action=ask_user.

slots.description: Values stated in the request. Leave a slot out if the user did not say it; never guess.

target_system.description: The system, module or endpoint under test, in the user's words (e.g. 'IKYS leave approval flow').

plugin.description: Plugin name, only if it exactly matches a name in <available_plugins>. The code validates it against the plugin registry; an unknown name is rejected as an invalid slot.

scope.description: Optional narrowing the user stated (endpoints, features, risk focus).

scenario_set_ref.description: Path or id of an existing scenario set the user wants executed.

execution_ref.description: Path or id of existing execution results the user wants evaluated.

run_ref.description: A previous run_id the user is asking about.

out_of_scope_reason.description: Required when intent=out_of_scope. stage_not_available = Acceptance, Regression, Reporting or Knowledge (not built yet).

rationale.description: One sentence: which words in the request decided the label.

name: run_domain_intel
description: Runs stage domain_intel (a02 Domain Intelligence): builds the domain model of the target system through its plugin. Callable only by the domain-intel subagent; the code rejects it if the stage is not next in the plan.

run_id.description: run_id of the current pipeline run.

name: run_scenario_gen
description: Runs stage scenario_gen (a03 Scenario Generator): produces the edge-case scenario set from the domain model. Callable only by the scenario-gen subagent; the code rejects it until every earlier stage in the plan has succeeded.

run_id.description: run_id of the current pipeline run.

name: run_execution
description: Runs stage execution (a05 Execution): executes the scenario set against the target system through its plugin. Callable only by the execution subagent; the code rejects it until every earlier stage in the plan has succeeded.

run_id.description: run_id of the current pipeline run.

name: run_evaluation
description: Runs stage evaluation (a06 Evaluation): scores the execution results and produces verdicts. Callable only by the evaluation subagent; the code rejects it until every earlier stage in the plan has succeeded.

run_id.description: run_id of the current pipeline run.

name: get_run_state
description: Returns a compact summary (status, intent, per-stage status, artifact refs) of a previous run. Use only when record_intent returned next_action=answer_status.

run_ref.description: The run_id the user asked about (slots.run_ref).

name: manager_output
description: Records the final result of the run and ends the Manager's work. Use exactly once, as the last call, whatever the outcome (completed, failed, needs_input, rejected, status_reported).

status.description: completed = every plan stage succeeded. failed = a stage failed or was blocked. needs_input = one clarifying question. rejected = out of scope. status_reported = answered a run_status request.

stages_run.description: One entry per stage delegated in this run, in execution order. Empty if nothing was dispatched.

artifact_ref.description: artifact_ref from the stage result; never the artifact content.

clarifying_question.description: Required when status=needs_input. Exactly one question, in the user's language.

redirect.description: Required when status=rejected. What ECVT can do instead, or where the request belongs.

summary.description: At most 3 sentences in the user's language: what ran, the outcome, where the artifacts are.
